conversation.content: Mhmm. Okay. And if you could wave a wand and improve how we go about this and how decisions are made regarding salinity, are there any things that you would do to change it? If Gavin Newsom had just come to you and asked you how you would like to do it.

conversation.content: I would like to see the environment, someone sit at the table with a big say who was watching out for the environment, because of course if we do lose freshwater flows through here through a conveyance, how much salt comes in, you know will develop another environment, is that okay? Salt marsh up what was freshwater marsh before? So I would love to have a strong voice there and I also would like to have a strong voice for Northern California, recreational boaters, and residents who, you know, people that live on the Delta that have their farms, their [...], their orchards on the Delta. conversation.speaker: BM
